requirements.title: Single generative call
requirements.description: An automatic packaging run performs at most one generative AI call and persists the count.

requirements.title: Deterministic analysis contract
requirements.description: Analysis produces metadata, transcript, scenes, subjects, faces, safe zones, edge insets, audio envelope, beats, and density without generative AI.

requirements.title: Validated Packaging IR
requirements.description: Packaging IR is schema-validated and contains canvas, style, timeline, constraints, and export hints.

requirements.title: Local plan persistence
requirements.description: Packaging IR and resolved plans are persisted locally and remain editable offline.

requirements.title: Registry manifest contract
requirements.description: Effects are described by an independent manifest contract with capability metadata and license provenance.

requirements.title: V1 registry breadth
requirements.description: V1 supports at least eight packaging categories and at least thirty registry effects.

requirements.title: Deterministic registry resolver
requirements.description: Registry resolution scores candidates deterministically and never requires an AI-selected final template ID.

requirements.title: Seeded Motion DSL
requirements.description: Motion is compiled from a finite DSL vocabulary with seed-controlled deterministic behavior; AI cannot emit keyframes.

requirements.title: Independent edge insets
requirements.description: Top, bottom, left, and right edge insets are independently configurable and enforced.

requirements.title: Subject avoid and foreground
requirements.description: Subject avoid and foreground relations are resolved deterministically with configurable padding.

requirements.title: Candidate layout solver
requirements.description: Layout uses normalized coordinates and evaluates preferred plus fallback zones using deterministic placement scoring.

requirements.title: Deterministic collision resolver
requirements.description: Collision resolution handles overlay, subtitle, subject, face, edge, safe-zone, and PiP conflicts without AI.

requirements.title: Deterministic fallback chains
requirements.description: Every V1 effect has a deterministic fallback chain and failed layout never masquerades as successful primary placement.

requirements.title: Packaging Validator
requirements.description: Packaging Validator checks geometry, typography, timing, visual, and runtime constraints without AI.

requirements.title: Snapshot QA and auto repair
requirements.description: Snapshot checkpoints are generated before full render and validator failures use only deterministic repairs.

requirements.title: Resolved timeline compiler
requirements.description: Final runtime timeline is compiled from resolved plans; render code never reads raw AI JSON directly.

requirements.title: Preview/render separation
requirements.description: Preview and final render are separate paths; preview/scrub does not invoke final export.

requirements.title: MP4 and transparent WebM
requirements.description: V1 exports normal MP4 and transparent WebM when the host codec supports it, with explicit capability errors otherwise.

requirements.title: Edits without AI
requirements.description: Theme, template, color, font, subtitle style, safe area, subject padding, speed, intensity, opacity, aspect ratio, and format edits reuse existing IR without another AI call.

requirements.title: Locked user override
requirements.description: AI intent, resolved state, and locked user override are persisted separately; locked overrides are not auto-moved.

requirements.title: Deterministic replay
requirements.description: The same IR, registry version, engine version, and seed produce stable resolved output.

requirements.title: No automatic AI retry
requirements.description: Invalid AI JSON is repaired locally once; if still invalid, the run fails without an automatic second AI call.

requirements.title: Packaging observability
requirements.description: Telemetry records AI success/failure, registry/layout fallback, collision repair, dropped overlays, render/export outcomes, manual override, and aiCallCount.
